issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 requests the number (count) of swimming pools in municipalities with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution implementation returns the names of the swimming pools instead of a single numeric count. This mismatch between the expected aggregate numeric result and the provided row-wise string result will confuse students and make automatic grading against the specification fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution query to return a single count. For example: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Schwimmbad, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000; Update the solution file aufgabe04.sql accordingly so it matches the problem requirement.
